text:
nora: Heads-up opening PR to slim down the Function/Tool Calling examples. Full JSON dumps are useful but noisy in quickstarts. I'll swap most inline examples for a compact envelope and add a single full-example appendix. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1821 :eyes:
cal: 👍 Compact is the right call. Please keep one unabridged example for debugging in the appendix so integrators can inspect every field.
paul: Also spotted a broken anchor from the migration guide to the schema appendix. Can you include that fix in the same PR?
nora: Yep. Plan: update docs/functions/calling.md to use compact envelopes, create docs/appendix/structured-output-full.md, and update snippets/python/invoke_snippet.md and snippets/js/invoke_quick.md. I'll also add a short fallback snippet and a compatibility note about field names.
cal: Important: runtime now uses `invocation` for current models; legacy SDKs may show `tool_call`. Show `invocation` as canonical and add a parenthetical: "(legacy: `tool_call`)". Ops asked for that exact phrasing.
paul: For the fallback snippet show this pattern (py):
```python
resp = client.invoke(...)
out = resp['output'].get('compact')
if not out:
    # fallback to raw text when model returned unstructured text
    out = parse_unstructured(resp['output'].get('raw_text', ''))
```
cal: One-liner under snippet: "Prefer `compact` for deterministic parsing; `raw_text` is a best-effort fallback." Keep it short.
qa-bot: Suggested doc CI check: ensure every invoke snippet includes either `compact` or `raw_text`. We'll add a grep + exit non-zero rule to docs CI if approved: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/actions/runs/445566778
devops: Ops reminder: don't change examples of public API shapes without a compatibility blurb at top. Also avoid emojis in PR titles.
nora: Will add a small changelog entry and mark the PR as docs-only. Title set to: "docs: compact invoke envelopes + appendix + migration linkfix"
cal: Can you also run a quick grep for `tool_call` across /snippets and /docs so we don't miss legacy occurrences?
paul: I'll do that and open tiny follow-up PRs for any leftover mentions, adding the compatibility note where appropriate.
qa-bot: When you push, please include a quick note in the PR description listing files changed and the CI lint added. Helps reviewers.
nora: Good call. I'll include details and request reviews from @cal and @paul. Pushing changes now.
cal: Thanks — will review after standup.
paul: LGTM pending the grep pass, and confirm the appendix anchor fix resolves the migration guide link.
qa-bot: PR updated: link fix applied, snippets adjusted, changelog added. CI lint queued.
devops: Merging guidance: one approval + CI green is fine for docs-only.
nora: Thanks team — should reduce confusion in quickstarts and keep the full schema available for debugging.
